mechanism: Trimethoprim inhibits renal tubular secretion of potassium and reduces GFR, while bumetanide causes potassium wasting, creating opposing effects on serum potassium; both drugs can increase serum creatinine and reduce renal function.
action: Monitor serum potassium, creatinine, and renal function closely; consider potassium supplementation or alternative diuretic; assess risk-benefit in patients with baseline renal impairment.
